findings.location: Paragraph with Proverbs quotation (source.html paragraph with Solomon quote)
findings.source_quote: “For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken” (Proverbs 3:26).
findings.suggested_fix: Translate into natural, idiomatic Italian while preserving the meaning exactly. Example: “Poiché il SIGNORE sarà la tua fiducia e proteggerà il tuo piede dal cadere” (Proverbi 3:26). Or keep closer to the existing literal wording but correct idiom: “Poiché il SIGNORE sarà la tua fiducia e terrà il tuo piede dal venir preso” (Proverbi 3:26).
findings.translation_quote: “Poiché il SIGNORE sarà la tua fiducia e terrà il tuo piede dal venire preso” (Proverbi 3:26).

findings.location: Poem block (the hymn stanza in the <div class="poem">)
findings.source_quote:
When all Thy mercies, O my God,
    My rising soul surveys,
    Transported with the view, I’m lost
    In wonder, love and praise.
findings.suggested_fix:
The current translation conveys the words but reads awkwardly in Italian. Provide a smoother, idiomatic rendering that preserves the poetic sense and lineation. findings.translation_quote:
Quando tutte le Tue misericordie, o mio Dio,
la mia anima che sorge contempla,
Trasportato da quella vista, rimango smarrito
in stupore, amore e lode.
